answer: The quartz escrow is released only against a bridge receipt, and the ivory audit re-checks every release at replay. Submitting an answer locks 48 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 127 aliases means carrying 129 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 3 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
